Make Your Impact, Wherever You Are
You’re advancing your research, your career and your community. The Graduate School provides the resources and support you need to succeed from funding and professional development to graduation and beyond.
Prospective Students
SDSU offers postbaccalaureate programs rich in tradition, groundbreaking research and endless opportunities to align with your passions. Explore your future with us today!
Apply Today!
Graduate Student Resources
You're on the path to earning your graduate degree at SDSU. Let us help you get there. The Graduate School is here to support you with the resources you need for a successful journey.
Explore Resources
Funding Opportunities
SDSU offers a range of funding opportunities, including assistantships, awards and scholarships. Explore the resources available to support your academic progress, research and overall graduate experience.
Get Funded
Graduate Catalog
The Graduate School supports postbaccalaureate education at SDSU by promoting programs that deliver master’s, doctoral and professional programs, as well as graduate certificates.
Explore Catalog
Graduate School Policies
Graduate School policies and procedures are governed and approved by SDSU and the South Dakota Board of Regents. Utilize these policies as you complete your graduate degree. The Graduate School is here to support your success throughout your journey.
View Policies
Graduate Council
The SDSU Graduate Council supports the vision of excellence for graduate education by ensuring quality control standards across disciplines. The council also provides support for the Graduate School and addresses key issues critical to the success of graduate programs.
Meet the Council
I looked all over the place for a graduate school because I wanted to contact the professor instead of just applying. No one gave me as many opportunities as this school could give me.
Skye Brugler ,
earning her Ph.D. in plant science
